Jeet is slang for selling a token shortly after buying it or after its launch, often for a quick profit. Jeet is used in forums and social media to warn that early sellers can harm other holders. Jeet describes a risk to consumers who buy later at inflated prices.

DYOR is an abbreviation for do your own research. DYOR is used as a warning that urges readers to verify information independently before making financial decisions. DYOR is posted in forums and social media to caution against relying on promotional claims.

DEGEN is short for degenerate. DEGEN describes a trader who takes highly speculative, high-risk positions. DEGEN is used in forums and social media both to accuse others of reckless trading and as a self-description.
